topic_title: Vehicle Maintenance for Safety — Tires, Brakes & Lights
prompt: How frequently should windshield wiper blades be inspected and replaced under hot Texas sun conditions?

options.text: Only when the wiper arms break off completely from the vehicle cowl assembly
Once every ten years regardless of environmental weather exposure or sun
Every six to twelve months, or immediately when they streak, chatter, or smear
Wiper blades never need replacement if cleaned with petroleum solvent gels
